assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a completely NEW photorealistic premium editorial product photograph FROM SCRATCH: design and generate the ENTIRE image including the ceramic mug, printing, lighting, props, support surface and background. This is a conceptual sample for the Mexican creative personalization studio Zzaay, not a delivered real product. Square composition, high resolution. Art direction: refined bold independent design studio, tactile physical materials, deep burgundy #a13255, warm ivory #f7f4ed, subtle gold accents. Hero product is one realistic glossy white standard straight-sided ceramic 11 oz coffee mug, correctly formed open rim and continuous single handle, plausible volume and proportions, full mug including handle and bottom visible, taking about 65–72% of image height so the printed design is legible at 450px display. High-end art-directed commercial photography with intentional composition, real studio shadows, natural ceramic reflections and real-looking sublimation ink wrapping along the cylinder. ALL objects and surroundings must be newly generated. No black rotating display base, no gray cloth backdrop, no cables, no reference-photo setup, no collage of cutouts, no vector illustration or flat UI mockup, no floating text outside the mug, no watermark, no stars or asterisks, no extra mugs, no invented Zzaay logo. SCENE: an expressive creative morning still life. The white mug rests on a low matte burgundy cylindrical ceramic plinth, with a folded warm peach paper sheet curving softly behind it on a seamless warm ivory studio surface. A single short wine-colored silk ribbon rests beside the plinth, understated. Directional late-morning light from upper left makes a strong beautiful diagonal soft-edged shadow. Slightly elevated three-quarter camera, mug handle fully visible on the right, front print facing camera. Styling feels thoughtful, sculptural and modern rather than a stock coffee scene. PRINT ON THE MUG ONLY: exact Spanish phrase "Haz que hoy cuente." in elegant bold burgundy editorial serif, "hoy" large italic and other words balanced on two supporting lines. One restrained champagne-gold brushed underline. Printing is integrated into ceramic glaze and follows surface curvature, not a pasted screen overlay. No other text.
